source_records.body: I accept the manual section order for Hazel loom manual. I close Hazel loom manual. While closing Hazel loom manual, I do not accept the Hazel repair panel. At this review, cancel the Hazel repair panel. There is no time for the repair panel in this review window.
I believe issuance for Hazel loom manual is complete because the local preview finished.

For Hazel, you can issue the manual only after Avi accepts the repair panel. For Hazel, permission to issue the manual also requires that the bench record includes a jam test. Both conditions for permission to issue the manual in Hazel are necessary because a normal weave run does not exercise the repair.

In Topaz, the loom exhibit is independent of the Hazel loom manual. For Topaz loom exhibit, use wooden stands for the loom exhibit. I want the Topaz loom exhibit kept in planning until its own review.
Fictional status record for Topaz loom exhibit. Topaz loom exhibit remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

Reopen the Hazel repair panel because a replacement shuttle jams differently. The Hazel repair panel must add the shuttle jam steps. The accepted Hazel loom manual stays closed while the repair panel is open.
Fictional local record for Hazel loom manual. The first preview contains the requested manual section order. This record covers a local preview only.
I will put the Hazel loom manual preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 11.

For Hazel, open the loom manual work item. For Hazel loom manual, keep the old part names in brackets because the workshop labels still use those names. At this opening meeting, Hazel loom manual is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Hazel loom manual sets thread tension to 7 units. The repair panel is a separate follow-up to Hazel loom manual.
This chat continues the same Hazel loom manual work item opened in the first chat. The Hazel loom manual constraint to keep the old part names in brackets still applies.
Correction for Hazel loom manual: use thread tension of 5 units, replacing my initial value of 7 units. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Hazel loom manual.
For the next step on Hazel loom manual, send jam cases to the bench team. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.

Fictional execution receipt for Hazel loom manual. The recorded command assembled a local manual draft for Hazel loom manual. The recorded command did not perform issuance for Hazel loom manual. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
